title: Restart level from pause leaves the game paused and unresponsive
observed: After esc (pause) and click:btn-restart, the event log shows 'restart' but mode stays 'paused'. The state and HUD reset to the starting values, but every following wait tick changes nothing: the timer stays at 300 and the clock does not advance. The game does not resume.
expected: Restart level resets the level (score 0, 3 lives, items back) and the game is running again straight away. Subsequent ticks should advance the game in the playing mode, with the timer dropping by 1 per running tick.
